title: Softest pillow covers I've had by far!
text: Softest pillow covers I've had by far!. These are by farrr the softest pillow covers I've had probably, I haven't really had that many (to be fair haha) but these are super comfortable, soft, and combined with my super soft pillows they work just fine! I love how soft they are and completely flat because I hate going down on any pillow only to find some sort of weird decoration or have the fabric feel uncomfortable in some way, these covers are just perfect for me that way I love soft things and am very sensible and love touching things and when it comes to pillows I love squishing them so much! So this is just great, and also very relaxing texture I don't know I definitely like them I know the design is not a big deal but I like them nonetheless and they look great as well.
